known_limitations: Does not include soil texture class (Red, Black, Laterite, Alluvial), growing season (Kharif/Rabi/Zaid), irrigation source, or taluk-level regional constraints.

Contains synthetic/augmented uniform-like distributions around crop reference ranges rather than raw multi-year field trials; therefore ML predictions alone must NOT be treated as standalone agronomic advice.

Does not include Karnataka-specific staple dryland crops such as Ragi (Finger Millet), Jowar (Sorghum), Groundnut, or Arecanut; those are handled explicitly through the configurable agronomic rule engine and transparent fallback labeling.
